App details

Last Done

Remember when you last did a recurring task and when it is due again.

In the worksPlannedAndroid

What it’s for

Record a recurring task with one tap, see when it was last done and its history, and optionally set intervals, reminders and a due-date countdown.

Main features

  • Record completion with one tap.
  • See past completions and elapsed time.
  • Choose repeat intervals and optional reminders.
  • Organize tasks into categories.

This app is being planned and is not yet available to download. The description presents its intended functions.

Features in detail

Last completion, due dates and history

Record what you last did

Create a named item, such as watering plants, then tap Done now to record the current time. See when it last happened and elapsed time; a new item says it has not happened yet. A brief Undo reverses an accidental entry. No interval is required.

History and average interval

Open an item’s chronological history to add an older event, edit its time or delete it. Last-done and due values recalculate. With at least two events, see average time between them; it is information only and does not choose your next deadline.

Optional intervals and reminders

Set a number of days, weeks, months or years after the last recorded completion. See days remaining, due today or overdue; without a completion there is no calculated due date. Opt into a local reminder when a due date exists. Android notification permission affects alerts, not tracking.

Categories, lists and archiving

Create or rename categories and assign one to an item. Browse active, category, due, recently completed, overdue and archived views. Deleting a category keeps its items. Archive items to keep their history while suspending reminders, and restore them when useful again.

Do not press!

Tap the About logo seven times to reveal a Do not press button. Press it to see how long ago you pressed it; pressing again restarts that playful counter. Close it without creating or changing any tracked event.

Use, settings and availability

Offline use

The main functions are designed to work on your device without a JN86 account. Ads, purchases and external links may need internet.

Language, settings and help

Choose one of eight app languages and adjust the available settings. About provides privacy information and a link to voluntary JN86 support. Support does not unlock paid functions. Availability is shown below.

Ads and optional ad removal

All described functions are planned to be free, with banner ads and optional one-time Google Play ad removal. No subscription is planned. The purchase screen shows the actual local price; purchase restoration uses Google Play.

Availability

This app is being created. The features described here are planned; it is not yet available to download.
